headline: KS Smart Technologies shareholders approve QIP and capital raise
summary: KS Smart Technologies Limited shareholders passed three resolutions approving capital increase, FPI limit hike, and fund raising via QIP/FCCB.

headline: Aikyam Financial to acquire 26% stake in Inani Securities
summary: Aikyam Financial Services Private Limited has filed a public announcement for an open offer to acquire up to 26% equity stake in Inani Securities Limited at ₹60 per share.
